roadmap_impact.summary: The LangGraph parity prototype is a strategic, flag-gated future runtime option. It does not change current production wiring but defines a concrete implementation path that preserves all Native V2 guarantees.

impact_areas.current_state: NativeAgentRuntimeV2 is the sole canonical backend for /v2/chat/agent.
impact_areas.proposed_change: Add an optional LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 selectable via AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph_parity; default remains native.
impact_areas.benefit: Enables future LangGraph-based features (cycles, conditional edges, streaming) without forced migration.

impact_areas.current_state: Governance, path blocking, mode escalation, and approval tokens live in governance.py and ToolGatewayV2.
impact_areas.proposed_change: Keep all governance logic in native modules; LangGraph nodes call them as pure functions.
impact_areas.benefit: No new governance surface; bypass risk is minimized because tool execution still routes through ToolGatewayV2.

impact_areas.current_state: Per-run trace.jsonl and checkpoint.json are the canonical observability artifacts.
impact_areas.proposed_change: Preserve native persistence format; optionally add LangGraph checkpointer for resumability only.
impact_areas.benefit: Existing dashboards, tests, and audits continue to work unchanged.

impact_areas.proposed_change: Reuse api_adapter._build_capability_metadata so parity backend returns identical schema.
impact_areas.benefit: Clients and smoke tests do not need backend-specific handling.

impact_areas.current_state: Smoke tests validate native backend and benchmarked LangGraph isolation.
impact_areas.proposed_change: Add parity smoke test comparing native and parity outputs for the same goals.
impact_areas.benefit: Regressions in parity implementation are caught before any flag is enabled.

impact_areas.current_state: LangGraph runtime is a 33-line toy graph.
impact_areas.proposed_change: Implement a full parity wrapper across 7 phases, estimated medium effort.
impact_areas.benefit: Provides a real evaluation target for LangGraph value without destabilizing production.

recommended_sequencing: Complete remaining Native V2 capability improvements (Front 03 recommendation A).
Begin Phase 0 skeleton in a new front: create langgraph_parity_runtime.py with compiling StateGraph only.
Proceed through Phases 1-5 with isolated tests; do not wire runtime.py until parity smoke test passes.
Only after smoke parity passes, add optional AGENT_V2_BACKEND flag wiring in runtime.py.
Run full regression suite before any production flag activation.
blocking_decisions: Whether to allow MemorySaver only or also SqliteSaver for checkpointer (default: MemorySaver for prototype).
Whether to expose parity backend via environment variable or operator preset only (default: environment variable for safety).
Whether to deprecate the existing toy langgraph_runtime.py or leave it untouched (default: leave untouched).
success_metrics: Parity smoke test capability_metadata keys match native 100%.
Parity smoke test governance blocks match native for write-intent probes.
No change in default backend without explicit flag.
Existing native smoke tests continue to pass at 100%.
